description: rag-plugin hooks. Both run hooks/hook_launcher.py through the standard portable launcher (PLUGIN_STANDARDS 1.1): a missing or unexpanded path exits 0 before any interpreter starts, and python3, python and py -3 are tried in turn. (1) PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell lock-conflict guard (guarded): asks before a CLI command that would fight the Qdrant lock while the service is up; never denies. (2) UserPromptSubmit context injector (advisory, every exit normalised to 0): resolves the project scope, runs a scoped relevance probe, injects one compact block.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_launcher.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s" lock-conflict; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_launcher.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s" context-inject; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
